messages:
vika: Running the onboarding quickstart under a modest load and seeing short 429 spikes. Console shows steady quota, so looks client-side.
aj: what are the sample defaults?
vika: quick paste:
```js
const client = new RedwoodClient({
  maxInflightRequests: 12,
  prefetchPages: 2,
  pageSize: 32,
  retry: { maxRetries: 2 }
});
```
sam: 12 inflight + prefetch 2 -> transient surges. If token cost per request is ~150 tokens that will create bursts that exceed a small account's tokens/sec.
kim: parity callout: our python quickstart uses max_inflight=5. surprise defaults across sdks = onboarding pain.
vik a: short-term I can patch quickstart to safer numbers and add an inline leaky-bucket helper. propose defaults: maxInflightRequests: 4, prefetchPages: 0.
aj: also add jitter to retries in example and a tiny troubleshooting note: "If you see 429s on onboarding lower maxInflightRequests/prefetch, enable jittered backoff, check token QPS in Console."
ops-bot: created incident-tracker note to surface this pattern to support.
sam: longer term: SDK parity PR to standardize defaults and an opt-in aggressive mode flag. also emit `client.inflight` metric by default so devs can see burstiness locally.
vik a: i'll push the quickstart patch + README blurb and tag @support-runbook. thanks all. :+1:
kim: great. this should reduce onboarding surprises.
